overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of Oklahoma women's gymnastics team for winning the 2025 national championship of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA), the program's seventh national title. It notes the team's winning score, its 33-2 record, its Southeastern Conference regular-season title, and the All-America honors earned by its athletes, including an individual all-around national title. It recognizes the team's hard work and the excitement it brought to the university and the state. The resolution is purely ceremonial. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 1, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution properly honors student-athletes for an outstanding championship season.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
